The '''Xa Fel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xa Fel/Legends|Xa Fel]].
